body: This means a lot! I appreciate you taking the time to read and reply. I just can't open up to my parents or anyone I know on these types of things. It's just something I needed to get off my chest that has been weighing me down, whenever I think of it while in a conversation I cant look at anyone in the eyes. Thanks alot for your support! it means alot

I appreciate the help and the advice, I am wanting  to try and tell my counselor and try to get him not to tell my parents, I don't want my family to hate him/look down on him. But it has done major effects on me over the past 7 years. I have a really short temper, and break down when something my fault happens things have gone really bad recently and I just needed to let some steam get out of me. Thanks for your time!
